detail.longDescription:
The problem must surely be *especially* bad among the pettier tyrants of #tech and #business because, as (I believe it was) the famous supervillain Henry Kissinger who pointed out that academic poliltics are *especially* vicious because the stakes are so small, it's the nobodies and the cyphers in the world of business and technology who nurse the deepest hatreds. They feel the most inadequate, like they've fallen the furthest possible from the dizzying heights they feel genetically entitled to occupy, and therefore they're the most toxic and bigoted and self-important of human beings. You know...like Linus Torvalds or that DHH clown or James Damore or any of the other teeming myriads of little dictators who swarm about the #programming culture.

(etc.)
